title: 宇航员候选人资格
problem_statement_md:
除了其他身体健康要求外，宇航员候选人必须有完美的视力（100%），他们的身高必须在62和75英寸之间(大于62且小于75)。

编写一个程序，相应地将视力百分比和身高（英寸）作为输入，如果满足给定条件，则打印 "pass"，否则打印 "fail"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logical operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Along with other physical health requirements, astronaut candidates must have perfect vision (100%) and their height must be between 62 and 75 inches. Write a program that accordingly takes the vision percentage and height (in inches) as an input and prints "passed" if given conditions are satisfied and "failed" if otherwise.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
100
80

[b]Sample Output[/b]
failed

[note]Both of the given conditions must be met to pass the test.[/note]
hint_md: 必须满足两个给定条件才能通过满足宇航员的要求；
